title: Northgate Optical Option Handling Fee Schedule
content:
**Option handling fee on Northgate Optical lens option refunds.** The option handling fee is waived when the job is cancelled no more than 3 calendar days after its order date and is 3.00 when it is cancelled 4 to 14 calendar days after it. A cancellation later than 14 calendar days after the order date is outside this schedule.

| Calendar days after the order date | Option handling fee |
|---|---|
| 0 to 3 | waived |
| 4 to 14 | 3.00 |

**Counting.** Calendar days after the eyewear job's order date, up to the day of the cancellation, when the refund is worked out; a cancellation on the order date is 0 days after it.

### Edges (hypothetical job ordered on 10 September 2025)

| Cancelled on | Days after the order date | Fee |
|---|---|---|
| 13 September 2025 | 3 | waived |
| 14 September 2025 | 4 | 3.00 |
| 24 September 2025 | 14 | 3.00 |
| 25 September 2025 | 15 | outside this schedule |
